status: Partial Charger-family implementation; six-gate acceptance remains open.
attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors; behavior summaries derived from the pinned article are CC BY-SA 4.0. Local tuning, geometry and test interpretation are separately identified.

sources.supports: Variant movement, Drowned diagonal death volley and 50% Flooded Caves replacement, Dank speed/reflection/slowing trail/recovery, Princess diagonal acquisition and vulnerable pink tail, Level 2 slower cardinal acquisition with curved pursuit. Repentance+ Hagalaz detail explicitly excluded.
Exact IDs; base HP 20/22/26/26/40, contact1/1/1/1/2 for normal/Drowned/Dank/Princess/Level 2.

Positive room evidence: Drowned Flooded Caves/Necropolis -> bands 1/2; Dank Dank Depths -> band 2; Princess Ashpit -> band 1; Level 2 Corpse -> band 3. Separate Greed/Ascent routes are not ordinary standard pools.
Repentance My Shadow item producer, allied Charger damage/lifetime/cap and edition-specific interactions; source review only.

implemented: External shared charge extension rows select cardinal/diagonal acquisition, wall stop/reflection, bounded continuous steering, stationary recovery, contact damage, tar trail, compact tail hit volume and death volleys.
Drowned keeps normal cardinal motion and 10% more HP; real four fixed-diagonal death shots. Drowned Hive half-health summons now 35.2, derived from 70.4 parent definition.
Dank moves faster, reflects swept wall-normal components without tunnelling, leaves nondamaging slowing tar only while moving during a dash, and stops during recovery.

Princess uses diagonal acquisition/locked dash; compact armored head/midsection and pink tail share collision/render geometry. Actual nearest projectile shape selects armor/tail; piercing alone does not bypass head. Explosions/fire must reach the tail; explicit debug execution still works.
Level 2 has its own 128 HP definition, double source-contact conversion, slower dash and bounded in-dash steering toward the moving player.

Drowned 50% room replacement runs only in seeded Flooded Quarry. Local sediment decals, expedition name and combat-room flooded state identify the context; topology/heights/roads/rivers/story placement are not rerolled.

All four direct pool entries are sparse charge-lane specialists with threat 4/cap 1. Drowned replacements retain normal Charger source slots and their source cap, with one extra reserved threat point. Native generated-floor regression checks their real presence and source-band constraints.

Shared charge dispatch now advances fire-contact cooldown, including while stunned; repeated physical flame exposure no longer becomes permanently immune after the first tick. Native tests distinguish armored-front fire from repeated tail exposure.

deathward_adaptations.hp: Base HP multiplied by 3.2: normal 64, Drowned 70.4, Dank 83.2, Princess 83.2, Level 2 128. Starting player remains 100 HP/24 damage.
deathward_adaptations.movement: Normal/Drowned/Princess dash 11; Dank 17; Level 2 9.5, each before 1.1 movement multiplier. Duration 1.5/1.7/1.8, acquisition width .8, local wander .7..1.8. Native exact timers, acceleration and dash-end criteria are unmeasured.
deathward_adaptations.steering: Level 2 turn rate 1.1 rad/sec. Dank uses actual 3D swept collision normals with at most 4 impacts/tick; navigation/water edges have an explicit fallback reflection.
deathward_adaptations.recovery: Dank pauses .65 s within .8 s reacquisition delay. Others retain .7 s reacquisition delay with wandering.
deathward_adaptations.trail: Tar deposits every .12 s with radius .7/lifetime 2.5; slows via existing player slow state and never deals damage. Existing hazard cap applies.
deathward_adaptations.damage: Normal family contact 10, Level 2 contact 20 before existing hostile 1.25 multiplier. Drowned death shots 10/speed 7.
deathward_adaptations.armor: Tail center .65 and radius .35 of navigation radius; armored head/midsection also fit that hull. Bullet weak-point and blast/fire overlap policy is a 3D adaptation, not measured native hitbox/item-exception parity.
deathward_adaptations.stage_context: Four broad bands remain the approved mapping. Flooded Quarry is a local Flooded Caves analogue selected 2:1 Standard:Flooded in band 1; this frequency is not an Isaac probability. Sparse flat sediment art, not full shallow-water rendering. Only combat rooms without story sites receive flooded environment rules.
deathward_adaptations.variants: My Shadow 23.0.1 and Elleech 855.1.0 remain separate unfinished item/special-route behaviors. Neither inherits a complete-port claim from these controllers.
deathward_adaptations.density: Direct variant pool entries have cost 4 and cap 1. Conditional Drowned replacements are applied once per selected normal Charger source slot (source cap 2), with one additional threat point reserved per slot; stage specialist/actor/budget limits still apply. The direct-entry cap is not a global Drowned identity cap.

unresolved: Exact native acceleration, acquisition width, steering speed, recovery and dash termination values need measurement or final accepted adaptation review.
Generic champions, full item/status/team exceptions and mode-specific/Ascent routing are not completed by these normal variants.
Princess item-specific armor exceptions and exact source explosion/fire behavior remain unverified; current spatial-tail policy is documented local behavior.
Flooded Quarry context is functional and visible but does not reproduce full source water-floor art or native environment interactions.
All-camera mixed-threat readability, human/mixed-build floor balance and controlled Linux/WASM performance acceptance remain open.

23.0.1.name: My Shadow
23.0.1.status: Source contract reviewed; legacy implementation remains unverified and unported.

source_contract.producer: Repentance collectible 433 creates a delayed movement-following shadow familiar; enemy contact with that familiar spawns a friendly black Charger.
source_contract.movement: Untargeted wandering followed by cardinal charges toward enemies.
source_contract.lifetime: Only the current room; takes enemy contact and damaging hazards.
source_contract.explosions: Ordinary player explosions are exempt in the baseline; named ghost explosion sources can kill them.
source_contract.interactions: Athame death rings, Jumper Cables death counter, Ace conversion, Broken Modem/Stop Watch slowdown, Eraser normal-Charger precursor and Blood Puppy faction exception require explicit support. BFFS and Box of Friends have no effect.

excluded_edition_rules: Before Repentance: damage-triggered fear/spawn, 5 damage and 5-Charger cap.
Afterbirth only: Flooded Caves Drowned substitution and Punching Bag targeting.
23.0.1.runtime_gap: Legacy friendly flag prevents all damage, movement is not the reviewed shared charge controller, and collectible 433/familiar contact producer is missing. Do not enable in hostile floor pools or count as a completed port.
23.0.1.unknowns: Native follow delay, shadow hitbox dimensions, contact cooldown, damage conversion and complete status/item exceptions remain unresolved.

855.1.0.name: Elleech
855.1.0.status: Reviewed disposition corrected to dedicated Ascent encounter; implementation remains missing.
855.1.0.placement: Twelve positive-weight templates in rooms/36.backwards.stb; no ordinary stage-band evidence. Ascent wording must not be read as ordinary Downpour availability.
855.1.0.behavior_gap: Cardinal activation followed by indefinite pursuit, unlike Level 2 Charger. Native obstacle handling and discrepancy between article pursuit wording and infobox closest-cardinal wording require measurement or an explicit documented adaptation.
855.1.0.unknowns: Native shieldStrength damage-resistance semantics and pursuit/obstacle rules need explicit verification; source field 5 is not converted to a guessed damage multiplier.
